content.value_statement: Missing company and contact details slow research and sales preparation. This skill previews public-data matches, compares them with CRM records, and saves approved updates.
actual_capabilities: Look up company or person details using websites, work emails, LinkedIn profiles, or organisation numbers.
Compare lookup results with matching company or contact records.
Preview found data and differences before saving changes.
Fill empty fields and create missing company or contact records when requested.
Overwrite only fields the user confirms.
Find, count, and add qualified companies or lookalike companies within documented limits.
limitations: Results depend on public registers and connected data providers.
A personal email alone is insufficient for enrichment.
The skill does not guarantee that public data is current or complete.
Lead discovery and enrichment actions consume credits according to the documented pricing rules.

use_cases.title: Clean CRM Records
use_cases.description: Preview missing company and contact fields, compare them with existing records, and save only approved updates.

use_cases.title: Prepare Sales Research
use_cases.description: Research a prospect from a website, work email, LinkedIn profile, or organisation number before outreach.

use_cases.title: Build a Target List
use_cases.description: Count matching companies, review the expected credit cost, and add approved leads or lookalike companies.

prompt_templates.title: Enrich One Contact
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the available public sources to find missing details for this contact. Show a preview first and wait for approval before saving.

prompt_templates.title: Fill Missing CRM Fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this company record with public data. Fill empty fields only, identify every proposed change, and ask for confirmation before saving.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Prospect
prompt_templates.prompt: Research this company using its website and organisation number. Summarise industry, size, key people, and work emails, then show the record differences before any update.

prompt_templates.title: Find Approved Leads
prompt_templates.prompt: Find companies in the specified country, size range, industry, and keyword set. Report the count and credit cost first, then add up to the approved limit only after explicit confirmation.

output_examples.input: Enrich this company using its website and compare the result with our CRM record.
output_examples.output: Preview: industry and company size were found. The website matches the existing record. No changes were saved.

output_examples.input: Find software companies in Sweden with 20 to 100 employees.
output_examples.output: The search found 42 matching companies. Showing company records costs credits, and adding companies costs one credit per company. No companies were added.

output_examples.input: Fill missing fields for this contact, but do not overwrite existing values.
output_examples.output: The preview identified a job title and work email for empty fields. Existing values remain unchanged. Waiting for approval to save.

best_practices: Start with a preview and review every proposed change before saving.
Provide a website, organisation number, or LinkedIn profile when a personal email is insufficient.
Confirm the expected lead count and credit cost before requesting additions.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite existing fields without confirming the specific changes.
Do not add leads before the user reviews the count and credit cost.
Do not treat public lookup results as guaranteed current or complete.

faq.question: What sources can I use?
faq.answer: You can provide a website, work email, LinkedIn profile, or organisation number.

faq.question: Does the skill save changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. It previews results first and saves only after the user asks.

faq.question: What does Fill do?
faq.answer: Fill adds missing records and fills empty fields without replacing existing values.

faq.question: Can I overwrite existing data?
faq.answer: Yes. Overwrite replaces only the fields you confirm after reviewing the preview.

faq.question: How does lead discovery work?
faq.answer: Find leads reports the matching count first. Add leads runs only after approval and a review of the expected cost.

faq.question: Are repeated lookups charged?
faq.answer: Repeating the same lookup within one hour is free. Other sources and additions use the documented credit rules.
